tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool stone. Text on it: text, text-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Alternating sections, step tiles, table stripes, secondary button hover. Text on it: text (11.6:1), text-muted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, the hero card, inputs, article bodies, secondary button fill. Text on it: text (14:1), text-muted (7.6:1), accent (7.6:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Slate ink. All headings and body copy on surface, surface-2, panel and accent-soft. Also the back sheet of the mark and the band fill.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Ledes, nav, captions, helper text on surface (6.9:1) and panel (7.6:1). Never for body paragraphs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Garnet. Primary button fill (white label 7.6:1), kicker text and inline links on surface and panel (6.9:1 and 7.6:1), the one highlighted line in a record composition, list bullets. One garnet element per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and active fill. White label 9.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for callouts, step numbers, selected rows. Text on it: text (11.3:1) or accent (6.1:1). Never white text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label color on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Footer band and any dark strip. Text on it: on-band, accent-on-band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and the reversed wordmark on band (14:1).

tokens.name: accent-on-band
tokens.usage: The italic 'in', links and the front sheet of the reversed mark on band (7:1). Never on light surfaces.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and decorative card edges on surface and panel. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, the secondary button outline, dividers that carry meaning. 3.3:1 on surface, 3.6:1 on panel.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring only: 3px solid, 2px offset, on surface (6.3:1), panel (6.9:1), surface-2 (5.7:1) and accent-soft (5.5:1). Never a fill or text color.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text and error borders on panel (8.3:1) and danger-soft (6.9:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind an error message. Text on it: danger, text.

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: Understand your medical records before you apply.
styles.usage: H1. 40px on phones. One per page.

styles.name: display-2
styles.sample: What comes back in plain English.
styles.usage: H2 and section titles. 32px on phones.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.sample: A list of what is still missing

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header wordmark only, when the SVG can not be used. The 'in' is italic weight 400 in accent.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We read the records you already have and explain them in everyday words.
styles.usage: Ledes under H1 and H2, in text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If the records are not enough, we say so in writing.
styles.usage: All body copy. Never smaller than 17px on the marketing site.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Help with Social Security medical records. No outcome guarantees.
styles.usage: Captions, nav links, footer, form helper text.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above an H1 or H2, colored accent.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, bullet gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, phone side gutter, minimum tap gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, section rhythm on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on desktop, hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page-end breathing room above the footer band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, step-number tiles, the SAMPLE tag in compositions.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and photos.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The SAMPLE pill in page chrome only.

tokens.name: shadow-quiet
tokens.usage: The hero photo and the promise card. Nothing else is elevated.

tokens.name: cta-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the primary and secondary buttons and of inputs.

tokens.name: cta-header
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the header button.

tokens.usage: Content max width.
